# Prissy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** sixteen  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Farewell P15](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0015)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Prissy Andrews has a beautiful complexion and curly brown hair, which she wears done up elegantly. Her features include a smooth white throat, often adorned with a string of pearls.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)_

## Personality

Prissy Andrews is a sixteen-year-old student. She is dedicated to studying for the entrance examination into Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) at [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Goals

## History

Prissy Andrews was a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at school. She was present in the classroom during the afternoon lessons when [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) returned.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV.
